turnos.t: How can being big make a firm less efficient?

Through diseconomies of scale. Communication slows as messages pass through many layers and get distorted. Coordination gets harder across departments and countries. And staff who feel like just a number lose motivation, so productivity falls.
Can a whole area grow too big?
Yes, those are external diseconomies. Traffic congestion delays deliveries, and competition for land and workers pushes up rents and wages. Firms may then move somewhere cheaper.
